prompts.lobby: Create a production quality TEXTLESS raster UI background plate for a serious modern Korean fantasy action game, landscape 915:412 ratio. Mobile-first flat front view, restrained, not ornate. Modern Seoul Gwanghwamun under overcast dusk skies after supernatural gates appeared: distant smoke, muted violet gate glow and faint emergency red city lights. Dark desaturated slate-blue, urban tension, no luxury penthouse or golden sunset, no explosions. Skyline subdued and uncluttered. TOP 64/412 of canvas kept quiet and dark for HTML header. Exactly six evenly sized menu surfaces in three columns two rows. Logical coordinates on 915x412: x24,317,610 width281; rows y76 and239 height149. Each surface is one integrated finished material: very thin satin silver edge, transparent dark smoke-glass UPPER image window (height104), and a CLEARLY SEPARATED lower solid deep blue finely woven tactile name strip (height45), subtle fine engraved horizontal separator between window and name strip. The upper image windows are empty dark, with faint city backdrop showing, for later game object overlays. Second panel only has very subtle warm cafe light through glass to preserve a refuge feel. All other panels cool subdued. Do not add icons or objects or letters; no text/numbers, no fake graph lines, no bolts, no ornate heavy chrome, no thick bevels, no excessive neon. Physically coherent polished-but-practical contemporary finish, border and inner material generated together. Composition precise. Fill whole canvas.
